interventions.title: Keep the sessions you already like
interventions.summary: Do not add volume for its own sake. Protect two sessions you enjoy and treat them as non-negotiable calendar blocks.

interventions.title: Steady meals on busy days
interventions.summary: Your overall pattern looks balanced. Pack one simple lunch for the two longest workdays so grazing does not creep up.

interventions.title: Guard the sleep that already works
interventions.summary: Keep the wind-down you have. If a late week shows up, recover with the same bedtime the next night rather than a weekend lie-in marathon.

coaching.template: Noor, both the short- and long-term diabetes pictures stay low in this demo — maintain, do not overhaul. Your activity and weight are working for you. Keep the routines you already like, and tidy busy-day meals so they do not quietly drift.
